identity.description:
E5: cap nits only, after the cap dropped suggestions in recorded runs

D4c experiment E5: the cap on non-blocking findings. Refs #23 (the PR does not close it).

## Result

The cap dropped 22 findings in 8 of 190 recorded runs: 14 suggestions, 8 nits and no blocking finding. A cap on nits only posts 315 findings where the cap posted 293. The E5 rule fires, so the cap now caps nits only.

## Changes

- `src/merge/cap.ts`: every blocking finding and every suggestion posts. Nits post in ranked order up to the cap value. The formula and the `caps.non_blocking_*` keys do not change, so no repo config breaks.
- Tests: `test/merge.test.ts` tests the new cap. In `test/explain.test.ts`, the end-to-end fixture now uses two nits, because its two suggestions both post now.
- Docs: design section 3.6 and decision 10, `severity-policy.md`, and the README config rows now say that the cap applies to nits only. `docs/research/e5-nit-cap.md` is the note. TICKETS.md marks E5 done.
- The version goes to 0.14.0.

The experiment made no model call. The spend is $0.

## Checks

`npm test` (1504 passed), `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass.
